GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (22 Oct 45) LS
(SCAPIN - 174)
22 October 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Units Stationed at Puerta Princesa, Palawan Island, Philippine Islands.
It is directed that you furnish this headquarters a duly authenticated roster of all Japanese units (Ground, Naval and Air) which were stationed at Puerto Princesa, Palawan Island, Philippine Islands, on 14 December 1944; the full name of all officers in command of said units, their rank, and the location of the headquarters of each unit.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
